description: Extract artisan identity and registration details (MAIN onboarding, 5 fields)
name: ArtisanNeuralProfile

name.description: Full personal name of the artisan person (never a greeting, place, or craft)

pehchan_id.description: Government Pehchan card ID copied exactly as written (starts with PEH-)

phone.description: 10-digit mobile phone number starting with 6, 7, 8 or 9, copied exactly as written (this is not the 4-digit security PIN)

pin.description: 4-digit security PIN copied exactly as written (this is not the phone number)

trifed_id.description: Government TRIFED registration ID copied exactly as written (starts with TRIFED-)
